name: HCP Plastene Bulkpack Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, HCL Plastene Bulkpack Ltd deals in FIBC Jumbo Bags, PP Woven Sack Bags, PP Woven Labels and related products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
HPBL is a flagship of the Plastene Group of Companies. It is a plastic packaging manufacturer of FIBCs, small bags, AD star bags and multi-layer films

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 2.89 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 4.36% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 58.9 to 77.9 days.
